g.text: GALINI / L03 / aligned floor +6 m
Actual normalized floor boundaries and openings / separate floors share the same origin and scale
Read actual space
Dark blue: complete opaque building mass.
Colored faces: walkable floor at the labeled
Z. Gray outlined holes: open stair wells,
not floor. Green-gray ravine and tan rock:
scenic, inaccessible.
Movement / information
Cream breaks D01–D23 are movement openings,
each with declared width and headroom.
Purple W02/W03 are observation only. Hatched
flights and dashed road arrows are explicit
level transfers.
Shared occupied volumes
Laundry lower undercroft / upper frontage: 0
and +4. Press stair house: +4 and +8. School
lower arcade / occupied upper room: +4 and
+8, with 3.7 m clear below the upper slab.
Boundary contract
Thick edges: walls/screens. Thin tan:
guards. Purple dashed on lower plans:
suspended upper edges. Stair ends stay open;
side guards follow grade. Exact floor, edge
and support IDs: layout.json.
Review status
L03 developed prediction after R02 interest
return; focused School support repair.
Original body retained. No AML, collision
walk, measured sightline, timing or balance
acceptance. R02 and rejected L01 remain as
revision evidence.
Meters, right-handed Z-up, north +Y. Radius .30 / standing 1.80 / crouch 1.10 / step .30 / slope 42 degrees. The three cross-town commitments remain: shore, middle market crossing
and upper civic crossing.
